summary: Validated two new P1 features (Activity timeline + Hours-watched stats). All 20 backend pytest tests pass (5 new). All frontend surfaces verified: Dashboard hours tile, by-category chart, recent activity card, /activity route, Activity sidebar link.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~873 lines — still over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,categories,titles,stats,activity,suggestions,extension,public}.py with a shared deps module.
log_activity is invoked sequentially after the main write; consider asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget for lower latency on POST /titles & PATCH /titles since the result is best-effort.

GET /api/stats does N+1 DB calls (one find per category to compute by_category). Acceptable now but will be slow once a user has many custom categories — switch to a single $group aggregation keyed by category_id.
GET /api/activity has no pagination cursor — only limit. For long-lived accounts the timeline will need a 'before=<created_at>' style cursor.
ActivityFeed.jsx uses index as React key fallback (key={a.id || i}) — fine here since server always returns id, but worth dropping the fallback to surface bugs early.
Dashboard.jsx uses Math.max(1, ...by_category.map(c=>c.hours)); when by_category is [] this is Math.max(1) = 1 which is safe. OK.
Activity 'progress' description shows 'ep' even for reading kinds (manga/books) — minor UX polish: switch label by category.kind (ep vs ch vs pg).
DEFAULT_MINUTES fallback uses cat.get('kind') without normalizing — custom categories created via UI default to kind='custom' (20m), which is fine.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown still uses the deprecated FastAPI hooks — should move to a lifespan context manager.
stat-hours card uses bg-primary/10 border-primary/30 — contrast looks good in tokyo-twilight theme; verify on lighter themes (sakura-noir, etc) for AA contrast on the gradient text.
test_credentials: admin@hanabi.app / hanabi123 — admin currently has profile_public=true, auto_accept=true. Admin currently has 'True Beauty' and 'Squid Game' titles plus generated activity from prior test runs.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient users (test_*@example.com) and TEST_*-prefixed titles/keys, all cleaned up. Admin's existing titles (True Beauty, Squid Game) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Activity timeline + hours stats fully working end-to-end. Backend testids: GET /api/stats returns {minutes, hours, by_category:[{id,slug,name,kind,count,minutes,hours}]}; GET /api/activity is auth-required with limit param (capped at 200). Frontend selectors: data-testid stat-hours, hours-chart, chart-row-{slug}, activity-item-{i}, nav-activity. Dashboard shows up to 6 activity items; /activity page uses limit=100. Verified all 6 activity types render with correct icons + copy: add (+), progress (↑ with ep from→to), status (Tv2, 'Moved to status'), complete (CheckCircle2, 'Finished … 🎉'), remove (Trash2), extension_add (RadioTower, 'Hanabi added/auto-added … from the extension'). Suggestion accept and auto-accept paths both log extension_add with extra.auto=true on auto.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. One transient false-positive during the first browser run: the script checked stat-hours immediately after login while React state was still null (renders '—'). Fixed by waiting on page.wait_for_function until stat-total !== '—'. This is a test-script timing concern, not a product bug.
